note: Entries exist only where artefacts exist. Four of them name a field dump that is in the tree: the legacy Build A plane dump, the 100-ohm Build B vis dump, the live-run slot a press writes, and the one-time release volume under artifacts/. The S-parameter record beside Build A is from a different run, and that mismatch is recorded per entry rather than hidden; the Build B dump is a third run again and carries no S-parameters at all. Build A at 100 ohm and the series-R build have no artefact yet and stay listed as records so the gap is visible rather than absent.

structures.label: Build B - 100 ohm load (field dump)
structures.notes: The tree's only field dump of a second load, and the only second arm the picker can reach. Legacy schema emfit.wavedude/2 (still in VIS_SCHEMAS), provenance structure_id B with load_ohm 100, nt 1500 and nt_x 150 - so its timeline stops at 1500 of the run's 2400 steps and playback is a partial record. Its own nx is 62, i.e. n_line 54, which is NOT the 72x212x22 (n_line 64) that the build_A_50ohm sparams block attributes to run B: the 100-ohm S-parameters and this field dump are not the same run either. There is no S-parameter record for this dump at all.

structures.notes: The slot a press writes: emfit.vis/2, 2400 steps, a 24-frame |E| volume at volume stride 100, and a load trace beside it. A working file, not a record - every solve overwrites it, so this entry is record-only until a solve has run in this checkout, and afterwards it shows whatever was solved last. structures.label: Reference simulation - volume (example)
structures.notes: One-time release artefact, shipped once so a checkout can show a volume and a timeline without a solve. 46 keys, schema emfit.vis/2 (e_abs_volume 24x62x212x22, nt 2400), 40,407,762 B, sha256 ad7fb3692b905e6519c194e498c1e4b5ee10f21ff43c66144d7aad9b613ce7e4; regenerate with `python3 scripts/run_reference_sim.py`, which rewrites this npz and artifacts/reference_sim_run.json. Catalogue entry only for the constant: `DEFAULT_STRUCTURE` remains build_A_50ohm, but the boot default of a bare invocation now resolves to this entry. The npz records provenance structure_id "A"/50 ohm, so a multifreq request on this entry resolves to the Build A sweep, and there is no port-wave record for it (port_waves stays null with that reason).
